Key items in this email:

  • Prefix/KV cache warmup and cold-start regressions
  • Functional parity tests vs hosted model outputs (prompt set 1)
- Suggested cutover windows: Aug 28–29 OR Sep 2–3 (US PST overnight windows).

Attachments: capacity_matrix_v3.csv (csv), throughput_test_plan.md (md)

Please loop in procurement/legal as needed — I’ll coordinate scheduling with our Ops team.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Resource commitment & migration orchestration for EdgeBank - hosted→dedicated

Thanks Ben — quick notes from infra perspective:

- SKU recommendation: 6 x A100-80GB + 2 x H100-80GB for mixed workloads (batch vs low-latency fanout). This gives room for KV cache RAM and mixed-precision quant paths.
- Burst pool: yes, we can reserve a 20% burst pool but it will be preemptible for non-critical work; we'll document behavior in the SLA addendum.
- Rollback plan if quality drift >10%:
  1) Pause routing to Dedicated via SmartRouting policy (30s)
  2) Shift traffic back to Hosted model variant pinned to the same seed and quantization profile
  3) Snapshot KV cache state and collect failing prompts for root cause
  4) If rollback fails, escalate to on-call infra and open an incident (P1)
- Validation targets:
  • 95th latency <= 220ms at target QPS (TBD once we run throughput)
  • Throughput script: run 1h steady-state + 2x burst 15m intervals

I’ll attach the throughput script and the runbook to the shared Drive folder. Ops can run a dress rehearsal in staging Aug 26.

-Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
